text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Project Overview Document states the total approved budget is $2,400,000.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown's quarterly table also totals $2,400,000, and its notes say these figures reflect the originally approved budget.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Total | $1,700,000 | $460,000 | $240,000 | $2,400,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Note that the figures above reflect the originally approved budget."}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown also states that, after a Finance Committee revision in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to cover additional smart TV integration costs.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to account for additional smart TV integration costs not included in the original scope."}]},{"text":"The documents give two different total budget figures and do not say which one should be treated as correct.","kind":"absence","evidence":[]}],"conflicts":[{"topic":"Total project budget","claim_indexes":[0,1,2]}],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
